features.title: Today Page
features.subtitle: Your day, one swipe away
features.description: Build a personal side page with the things you care about: weather, calendar, headlines, tasks, photos, and quick information. Choose the cards and layout that work for you.

features.title: Home Modes
features.subtitle: A home for every part of your day
features.description: Save separate layouts, wallpapers, and visual choices for work, home, or focus. Switch modes yourself or let a schedule do it. Existing modes stay saved until you choose to uninstall this app.

features.title: Universal Font
features.subtitle: One typeface across KabirUI
features.description: Choose a typeface that carries through KabirUI screens, widgets, and app labels. Your current choice stays saved while this app is opted out, and uninstalling resets it to the default.

features.title: Adaptive Home
features.subtitle: Useful apps, right when you need them
features.description: Show a small row of useful apps based on launches through KabirUI. Optional Usage Access can improve suggestions using activity stored on this phone; Android asks separately, and the data stays on-device.
